name: Dine&Dash     01
text: Dine&Dash     01

Opening problem framing, not a measured claim about Georgia Tech students. The prototype addresses the effort of translating published menus into portions and keeping a record of consumption. No student survey or adoption study has established the size of this problem. Invite Dining leadership to assess whether this matches student feedback.

name: Dine&Dash     02
text: Dine&Dash     02

Dine&Dash is a student-built prototype, not an official Georgia Tech Dining product or approved nutrition service. The code currently supports Brittain, North Ave, and West Village. It uses published Nutrislice menu data. Sources: backend/app/nutrislice.py, frontend/src/App.tsx, backend/app/recommendations.py.

name: Dine&Dash     03
text: Dine&Dash     03

The app uses a deterministic beam-search optimizer, not a trained AI model. It searches up to four items with several portion sizes and scores calorie fit, protein/fiber shortfalls, fat, sodium, and category variety. Current meal weights and the calorie cap are developer-selected heuristics that need dietitian review. Current diet/allergy filters have limitations and do not establish allergen safety or halal certification. Sources: backend/app/recommendations.py:36-131, backend/app/planning.py:34-40, backend/app/main.py:148-172.

name: Dine&Dash     04
text: Dine&Dash     04

Alternatives retain saved diet/allergy filters and recalculate portions around the meal target. The app does not know real-time station inventory. Current-menu search uses the current hall/date/service and published nutrition. Configured regular opening hours may differ on holidays or exceptional closures. Sources: frontend/src/ExtraFoods.tsx, frontend/src/App.tsx, backend/app/planning.py:14-21, backend/app/meals.py, backend/app/recommendations.py:153-186.

name: Dine&Dash     05
text: Dine&Dash     05

Registration/login associates goals and meal history with individual accounts. The user icon opens My progress. Logging remains explicit, not automatic. Historical menus may be unavailable; the backend rejects missing/demo historical data instead of substituting current foods. All journal date/time boundaries use America/New_York. Older meals change their original day/week, not today’s budget. Sources: frontend/src/MealHistory.tsx, frontend/src/PastMeal.tsx, backend/app/meals.py, backend/app/planning.py:24-40, AUTHENTICATION.md.

name: Dine&Dash     06
text: Dine&Dash     06

This slide proposes collaboration; it does not imply an existing partnership, committed pilot, or measured student outcomes. Ask whether Dining would be interested in a product demonstration and review of data accuracy and nutrition assumptions. Before wider deployment, address account recovery, email verification, privacy/consent, and operational support. Sources for current limitations: AUTHENTICATION.md and backend/app/recommendations.py.
